pattern: には及ばない（にはおよばない）
purpose: Deny the need for an action or deny equality in comparison.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
V dictionary + には及ばない; N + には及ばない
There is no need to make a special trip here.
There is no need to thank me.
My skill does not match my teacher’s.
formation: V dictionary + には及ばない; N + には及ばない
restrictions: Verb use often reassures; noun use compares ability or quality.
mistake: Choose the sense from what precedes には.
